core.preview_domain_refusal_codes.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the numeric verdict codes the media server gave when it refused to play or convert an item. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_attempted_delivery.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: which way of delivering the video the app asked the server for before the server refused. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_source_video.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the video format class of the file the server refused. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_source_audio.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the audio format class of the file the server refused. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_raster.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the picture size class.

core.preview_domain_pipeline.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the playback pipeline stage.

core.preview_domain_http.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the HTTP status class.

core.preview_domain_buffer.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the buffered time class.

core.preview_domain_elapsed.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: time since an event.

core.preview_domain_hls_direction.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: whether streaming quality went up or down.

core.preview_domain_delivery_reason.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values.

core.preview_domain_original_phase.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the stage of an original-quality attempt.

core.preview_domain_original_outcome.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the result of an original-quality attempt.
